pictures.name: QR1-Plowing
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A stony field in Galilee at morning. a laborer in his thirties with a short brown beard, a sweat-stained undyed tunic and a cloth tied around his head, guides a wooden plow behind an ox; the plow blade has just struck the curved shoulder of a buried clay jar half-uncovered in the dark earth. He has stopped, staring down. Curiosity, a secret.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A lamplit market stall at night under a striped awning. a pearl merchant in his fifties with a silver beard, a rich wine-red robe and gold rings, holds a single large luminous pearl up between his fingers, his face lit in wonder by its soft glow, trays of lesser pearls forgotten on the table. pictures.name: QR6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern home office at night. A woman in her forties closes her laptop, picks up her coat and car keys, and smiles at a framed family photo on the desk, as if choosing to go home early. Warm lamp light. Choosing what matters.
